sub_site: whole blood (children with celiac disease and controls)

evidence.quote: Whole blood was collected from pediatric patients during clinically indicated endoscopies
V4 hypervariable region of 16S rRNA gene was amplified by PCR

controls.types: DNase/RNase-free water processed as negative control

evidence.quote: A sample of DNAse/RNAse free water was processed and sequenced along the with the blood samples as negative control

notes: Only phylum-level composition given (Bacteroidetes most abundant); genus-level only differential (Odoribacter, Bacteroides acidifaciens). Negative control sequenced but results not reported and no contaminant removal described. n_sequenced assumed 1 ('A sample'). No supplements available.
